<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Eco Adventure Brasil</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:#122b38;color:white;font-family:system-ui,monospace;text-align:center}
body{padding:clamp(6px,2vw,16px);overscroll-behavior:none;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
main{width:min(100%,850px);margin:0 auto}
h1{font-size:clamp(19px,4vw,30px);margin:7px 0 10px}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;image-rendering:pixelated;border:3px solid #e3bd70;border-radius:10px;background:#62c4ed;touch-action:none}
.hud{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 2px;font-size:clamp(11px,2.5vw,17px);font-weight:800;flex-wrap:wrap}
.controls{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:12px 0}
.controls>div{display:flex;gap:12px}
button{min-width:68px;min-height:64px;padding:12px 16px;border:2px solid #a6d9dc;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(#34768a,#205265);color:white;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(21px,5vw,28px);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #102f3c;touch-action:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
button:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #102f3c;background:#438da0}
#jump{min-width:116px;background:linear-gradient(#e7ad43,#bb7624);border-color:#ffe0a0;color:#271d0e;font-size:17px}
#restart{min-height:44px;min-width:0;background:#d18b31;color:#241b10;font-size:15px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:none}
p{line-height:1.45;font-size:clamp(12px,2.7vw,15px);margin:9px 0}
@media(max-width:600px){body{padding:6px}h1{margin:4px 0 7px}.hud{padding:6px 1px}.controls{margin:11px 2px 8px;gap:8px}.controls>div{gap:9px}button{min-width:74px;min-height:72px;border-radius:20px;padding:10px}.controls #jump{min-width:124px;min-height:76px;font-size:18px}main>p:last-of-type{font-size:11px}}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:520px){body{padding:3px}h1{display:none}.hud{padding:3px}canvas{max-height:58vh;width:auto;max-width:100%;margin:auto}.controls{margin:5px auto;max-width:500px}.controls button{min-height:54px;min-width:64px}main>p{margin:3px;font-size:10px}}

.game-wrap{position:relative;width:100%;overflow:hidden;border-radius:10px}
.victory[hidden]{display:none!important}
.victory{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:clamp(2px,0.8vw,6px);padding:5px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#142b37f5,#174b49f5);color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 4px #000}
.victory-title{font-size:clamp(18px,4.8vw,34px);font-weight:1000;color:#ffdb61}
.victory-subtitle{font-size:clamp(11px,2.4vw,19px);font-weight:900}
.victory-image{display:block;max-height:72%;max-width:96%;width:auto;height:auto;object-fit:contain;border:3px solid #ffe08a;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 4px 20px #0009}
.victory-score{font-size:clamp(12px,2.5vw,20px);font-weight:800}
#next-stage{min-height:36px;min-width:0;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:12px;font-size:clamp(12px,2vw,16px);background:#8ee5f0;color:#123748}#next-stage[hidden]{display:none!important}
#play-again{min-height:36px;min-width:0;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:12px;font-size:clamp(12px,2vw,16px);background:#f3bd49;color:#252016}
@media(max-width:600px){.victory{gap:3px;padding:4px}.victory-image{max-height:69%;max-width:98%}#next-stage{min-height:36px;min-width:0;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:12px;font-size:clamp(12px,2vw,16px);background:#8ee5f0;color:#123748}#next-stage[hidden]{display:none!important}
#play-again{min-height:29px;padding:3px 12px}}

.music-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin:8px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
#music-toggle{min-height:42px;min-width:175px;padding:8px 15px;font-size:15px;border-radius:12px;background:#287d75;box-shadow:none}
#music-toggle[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#9ad7aa;color:#163c30}
.music-tip{font-size:12px;opacity:.8}

/* Tela de derrota 100% em estilo jogo retrô, com pixels definidos */
.death-screen[hidden],.death-result[hidden]{display:none!important}
.death-screen{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:25;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:10px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#071126ed 0px,#071126ed 8px,#10213bed 8px,#10213bed 12px);image-rendering:pixelated}
.death-panel{position:relative;width:min(95%,530px);padding:clamp(10px,2.5vw,20px);background:#172b50;border:6px solid #ffda6c;outline:5px solid #080f25;box-shadow:10px 10px 0 #050b1b,inset 0 0 0 5px #45699a;color:#fff;text-align:center;font-family:monospace;overflow:hidden}
.death-panel:before,.death-panel:after{content:'✦';position:absolute;color:#ffdf79;font-size:20px;top:10px}.death-panel:before{left:12px}.death-panel:after{right:12px}
.death-heart{width:80px;height:72px;margin:0 auto 3px;position:relative;filter:drop-shadow(5px 5px 0 #070e21);image-rendering:pixelated}
.death-heart svg{width:100%;height:100%;image-rendering:pixelated;shape-rendering:crispEdges}
.death-title{font-size:clamp(21px,5vw,38px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:2px;color:#ffda6c;text-shadow:3px 3px 0 #8d3b58,6px 6px 0 #091229;margin:3px 0 12px}
.death-question{font-size:clamp(12px,2.5vw,18px);font-weight:900;color:#e9f7ff;margin-bottom:14px;text-shadow:2px 2px #0a1429}
.death-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(12px,5vw,30px)}
.death-actions button{font-family:monospace;font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(16px,3vw,22px);border:4px solid #f9f3cf;border-radius:0;min-width:clamp(90px,20vw,142px);min-height:52px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #0a132b,inset 0 -5px 0 #0004;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
.death-actions button:active{transform:translateY(4px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #0a132b}
#death-yes{background:#30a36b;color:#fff}#death-no{background:#c44c60;color:#fff}
.death-result{font-size:clamp(15px,3.4vw,25px);color:#ffe188;line-height:1.5;text-shadow:2px 2px #080f25}
@media(max-width:600px){.death-panel{border-width:4px;padding:9px;outline-width:3px;box-shadow:5px 5px #050b1b}.death-heart{width:60px;height:55px}.death-title{margin:2px 0 7px}.death-question{margin-bottom:9px}.death-actions button{min-height:43px}}

/* Tela de derrota ampliada: ocupa quase todo o espaço do jogo. */
.death-screen{padding:8px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#071126f5 0 9px,#112344f5 9px 13px)}
.death-panel{width:calc(100% - 20px);max-width:none;min-height:calc(100% - 22px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(5px,1.7vw,12px);padding:clamp(12px,3vw,25px);border:8px solid #ffda6c;outline:5px solid #060b1c;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 6px #4d75a2,10px 10px 0 #060b1c;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#15294d 0 16px,#1b345b 16px 32px)}
.death-heart{width:clamp(55px,12vw,106px);height:clamp(50px,10vw,90px);margin:0;flex-shrink:1}
.death-title{font-size:clamp(22px,5.7vw,48px);line-height:1.05;margin:0;text-shadow:4px 4px 0 #853c58,7px 7px 0 #080f25}
.death-question{font-size:clamp(13px,2.8vw,23px);margin:0}
.death-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;width:min(95%,620px);gap:clamp(12px,4vw,36px);margin-top:6px}
.death-actions button{flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:clamp(52px,9vw,86px);padding:8px 12px;font-family:monospace;font-size:clamp(19px,4vw,31px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:2px;border:0;border-radius:0;clip-path:polygon(8px 0,calc(100% - 8px) 0,calc(100% - 8px) 8px,100% 8px,100% calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) 100%,8px 100%,8px calc(100% - 8px),0 calc(100% - 8px),0 8px,8px 8px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 5px #fff0bd,inset 0 -12px 0 #0004;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 0 #081124);touch-action:manipulation}
#death-yes{background:#36bd77;color:#fff;text-shadow:3px 3px #155f40}
#death-no{background:#e45d6b;color:#fff;text-shadow:3px 3px #862b46}
.death-actions button:active{transform:translateY(4px);filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 0 #081124)}
.death-actions button:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}
@media(max-width:600px){.death-screen{padding:5px}.death-panel{width:calc(100% - 12px);min-height:calc(100% - 12px);padding:7px;border-width:5px;outline-width:3px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #4d75a2,5px 5px 0 #060b1c;gap:3px}.death-heart{width:clamp(35px,9vw,64px);height:clamp(32px,8vw,56px)}.death-title{font-size:clamp(17px,5vw,30px)}.death-question{font-size:clamp(11px,2.8vw,17px)}.death-actions{margin-top:2px;gap:10px}.death-actions button{min-height:clamp(38px,9vw,62px);font-size:clamp(15px,4vw,24px)}}

/* Informações do jogo são desenhadas no canvas, inclusive em tela cheia. */
.hud,.hud[hidden]{display:none!important}
/* Área de jogo maior, sem distorcer a resolução interna do pixel art. */
main{width:min(100%,1240px);max-width:1240px}
.game-wrap{width:100%;max-width:1240px;margin-inline:auto;border:4px solid #e4c16f;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #152b36,0 8px 0 #081922}
canvas{width:100%;height:auto;border:0;border-radius:0;aspect-ratio:20/11}
.controls{width:min(100%,840px);margin:16px auto 12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,46px)}
.controls .direction-pad{display:flex;gap:14px}
.controls .pixel-control{appearance:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-width:104px;min-height:92px;padding:10px 16px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34);border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(108,220,255,.97),rgba(25,118,172,.99));box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(6,22,37,.30),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.52),inset 0 -8px 14px rgba(8,49,82,.28);color:#fff;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;cursor:pointer}
.controls .control-symbol{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:34px;line-height:1;font-weight:900}
.controls .control-caption{font:900 11px/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px}
.controls .jump-control{min-width:148px;margin-right:clamp(8px,3vw,30px);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,236,138,.99),rgba(240,157,56,.99));color:#4f2d0d;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(60,31,7,.26),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.66),inset 0 -8px 14px rgba(137,73,14,.25)}
.controls .pixel-control:active,.controls .pixel-control.is-pressed{transform:translateY(2px) scale(.98);filter:brightness(1.09)}
.controls .pixel-control:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}
#fullscreen{display:block;margin:0 auto 8px;min-height:40px;min-width:186px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.32);border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2d6f88,#14455b);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(4,15,25,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28);font:900 14px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff}
@media(max-width:600px){body{padding:4px}.controls{margin:10px auto 8px;gap:12px;padding:0 10px}.controls .direction-pad{gap:9px}.controls .pixel-control{min-width:76px;min-height:76px;padding:6px 8px}.controls .control-symbol{font-size:28px}.controls .control-caption{font-size:10px}.controls .jump-control{min-width:114px;margin-right:12px}.hud{gap:5px}.game-wrap{border-width:3px}}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:600px){body{padding:2px}main{width:100%;max-width:none}h1,.music-controls,main>p{display:none}.hud{font-size:11px;padding:2px 8px}.game-wrap{width:min(100%,calc(69dvh * 20 / 11));margin:auto}.game-wrap canvas{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none}.controls{width:min(100%,780px);margin:6px auto 4px;gap:16px;padding:0 clamp(28px,6vw,80px)}.controls .pixel-control,.controls .jump-control{min-height:55px;min-width:86px;padding:3px 8px}.controls .jump-control{min-width:110px;margin-right:0}.controls .control-symbol{font-size:23px}.controls .control-caption{font-size:9px}.controls .direction-pad{gap:12px}#fullscreen{min-height:28px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px}}
.game-wrap:fullscreen{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100vw;max-width:none;height:100dvh;background:#071d2c;border:0;box-shadow:none}
.game-wrap:fullscreen canvas{width:min(100vw,calc(100dvh * 20 / 11));height:auto;max-height:100dvh}

/* Controles na tela cheia: toque direto, com pulo afastado da borda. */
.fullscreen-pad{display:none;pointer-events:none;position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:12;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-left));box-sizing:border-box}
.game-wrap:fullscreen .fullscreen-pad,.game-wrap:-webkit-full-screen .fullscreen-pad{display:flex}
.fs-left-group,.fs-right-group{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:14px;pointer-events:none}
.fs-directions{display:flex;gap:14px;pointer-events:none}
.fs-right-group{margin-right:clamp(28px,7vw,100px)}
.fullscreen-pad .fs-control{pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;width:clamp(70px,12vw,110px);height:clamp(70px,17vh,98px);min-width:0;min-height:0;padding:7px 6px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34);border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(110,220,255,.96),rgba(26,121,177,.98));color:#fff;font:900 clamp(24px,5vw,40px)/1 system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(6,22,37,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5),inset 0 -8px 14px rgba(8,49,82,.34);opacity:.95}
.fullscreen-pad .fs-control small{font:900 10px/1.1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:5px}
.fullscreen-pad .fs-jump{width:clamp(90px,15vw,138px);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,235,134,.98),rgba(237,154,56,.99));color:#4d2a0a;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(60,31,7,.28),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.65),inset 0 -8px 14px rgba(137,73,14,.28)}
.fullscreen-pad .fs-control:active,.fullscreen-pad .fs-control.is-pressed{filter:brightness(1.10);transform:translateY(2px) scale(.98)}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:480px){.fullscreen-pad .fs-control{width:clamp(60px,11vw,88px);height:clamp(60px,23vh,80px)}.fullscreen-pad .fs-jump{width:clamp(82px,14vw,116px)}.fs-right-group{margin-right:clamp(20px,6vw,68px)}.fullscreen-pad{padding-bottom:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}}

body.menu-active{padding:0;background:#081c33}
body.menu-active main{display:none}
#start-menu[hidden],#menu-dialog[hidden]{display:none!important}
#start-menu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#071b33}
.menu-art{position:relative;width:min(100vw,calc(100dvh * 1.7777778));aspect-ratio:16/9;max-height:100dvh;overflow:hidden}
.menu-art>img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:fill;image-rendering:auto}
.menu-credit{position:absolute;right:1.5%;bottom:2.2%;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;color:#fff6c0;font:900 clamp(10px,1.4vw,18px)/1.1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.02em;text-shadow:-2px -2px 0 #000,2px -2px 0 #000,-2px 2px 0 #000,2px 2px 0 #000,0 3px 10px #000c;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d1b2cab,#06111ec9);padding:.38em .72em;border:2px solid #f2d56a;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px #0007;white-space:nowrap}
@media(orientation:portrait){.menu-credit{right:2.5%;bottom:2.5%;font-size:clamp(10px,2.7vw,15px)}}
.menu-hit{position:absolute;border:0;border-radius:10px;min-width:0;min-height:0;padding:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
.menu-hit:active{background:#ffffff38;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #fff8;transform:none}
.menu-hit:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #fff5a2;outline-offset:0}
#menu-play{top:53.2%;height:8.6%;left:39.7%;width:21.8%}
#menu-options{top:65.0%;height:8.0%;left:40.0%;width:20.8%}
#menu-ranking{top:75.1%;height:8.0%;left:40.0%;width:20.8%}
#menu-exit{top:85.1%;height:7.8%;left:40.0%;width:20.8%}
#menu-dialog{position:absolute;inset:7% 20%;background:#14294df5;border:5px solid #ffdb68;outline:4px solid #071124;z-index:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;color:#fff;font:900 clamp(12px,2.4vw,23px)/1.4 monospace;text-shadow:2px 2px #000;box-shadow:8px 8px #0008}
#menu-dialog h2{font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,30px);margin:0;color:#ffe27a}
#menu-dialog p{margin:0;max-width:90%;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(12px,1.7vw,18px)}
#menu-dialog button{min-height:36px;min-width:120px;padding:6px 12px;font:900 clamp(12px,1.7vw,18px) monospace;border:3px solid #fff4b9;border-radius:0;background:#157ab4;box-shadow:3px 3px #000}
#menu-dialog input{width:24px;height:24px;vertical-align:middle}
#menu-dialog .settings-player-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;width:94%;text-align:center}
#menu-dialog .settings-player-row strong{overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#fff2b6}
#menu-dialog .settings-player-row #edit-player-settings{min-width:0;min-height:34px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(#2ba866,#116a40);font:900 clamp(11px,1.7vw,16px) system-ui,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}

@media(orientation:portrait){#menu-dialog{inset:8% 5%}#menu-dialog button{min-height:32px}}


/* Música visível dentro do próprio jogo, mesmo em paisagem e tela cheia. */
#music-prompt[hidden]{display:none!important}
#music-prompt{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:80;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:min(94%,400px);padding:14px 12px;background:#0c3446f7;border:3px solid #e3d17b;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #000a;border-radius:10px;font:700 14px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif}
#music-prompt strong{font-size:clamp(16px,3vw,22px)}
#music-prompt button{min-height:42px;min-width:180px;padding:7px 12px;font:900 15px system-ui,sans-serif;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:none}
#music-prompt-btn{background:#399e7d;border-color:#adffd0}
#music-prompt-dismiss{min-height:28px!important;min-width:0!important;padding:3px 7px!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;color:#d2e9ec;font-size:11px!important;text-decoration:underline}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:600px){#music-float{top:4px;right:5px;min-height:32px;min-width:82px;font-size:11px;padding:3px 5px}#music-prompt{gap:5px;padding:8px;font-size:12px}#music-prompt button{min-height:34px}}

/* Ranking completo, desenhado para celular vertical, horizontal e desktop. */
#start-menu.dialog-open .menu-hit{pointer-events:none}
#menu-dialog.rank-view{inset:clamp(7px,3.5vh,28px) clamp(8px,7vw,115px);padding:clamp(8px,2vmin,19px);border:3px solid #ffdf74;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#101e38fa,#154756fa);outline:2px solid #061326;box-shadow:0 10px 35px #000b;gap:7px;justify-content:flex-start;text-shadow:none;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
#menu-dialog.rank-view h2{font:900 clamp(19px,3.5vw,31px)/1.1 system-ui,sans-serif;flex-shrink:0;text-align:center;color:#ffdd75}
#menu-dialog.rank-view p{font-size:clamp(10px,1.5vw,14px);line-height:1.4;margin:0;max-width:100%}
#menu-dialog .rank-head{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#menu-dialog .rank-head p{text-align:left;color:#e1eff5}
#menu-dialog .rank-head strong{color:#ffe49a}
#menu-dialog .rank-views{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
#menu-dialog.rank-view button{border:1px solid #a5d5e0;border-radius:9px;min-width:0;min-height:31px;padding:5px 9px;font:800 clamp(10px,1.4vw,14px)/1.15 system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:none;background:#226b83;color:white;cursor:pointer}
#menu-dialog.rank-view button:focus-visible,#menu-dialog.name-view button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffdf74;outline-offset:2px}
#menu-dialog.rank-view button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#ffe59c;color:#16324b;border-color:#ffe59c}
#menu-dialog .rank-scroll{flex:1;min-height:0;width:100%;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #547989;background:#08172880;scrollbar-width:thin}
#menu-dialog .rank-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed;text-align:left;font:700 clamp(10px,1.55vw,14px)/1.25 system-ui,sans-serif}
#menu-dialog .rank-table th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#193c57;color:#ffe2a7;padding:8px 5px;z-index:1}
#menu-dialog .rank-table th:first-child{width:43px;text-align:center}
#menu-dialog .rank-table th:nth-child(3){width:74px}
#menu-dialog .rank-table th:nth-child(4){width:70px}
#menu-dialog .rank-table th:last-child{width:90px}
#menu-dialog .rank-table td.rank-time{font-weight:900;color:#9cf6df;white-space:nowrap}
#menu-dialog .rank-table td{padding:7px 5px;border-top:1px solid #3c5c6888;color:#f5faff;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#menu-dialog .rank-table td:first-child{text-align:center;color:#ffdf75}
#menu-dialog .rank-table tr.rank-mine{background:#316d5d77}
#menu-dialog .rank-table td small{display:block;color:#c4d8de;font:500 10px/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif;margin-top:3px}
#menu-dialog .rank-table td.rank-points{font-weight:900;color:#ffe9ac}
#menu-dialog .rank-empty{text-align:center;padding:18px 10px;color:#c6e5e9;font-size:clamp(12px,2vw,17px)}
#menu-dialog .rank-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%;flex-shrink:0}
#menu-dialog .rank-footer{font:600 clamp(9px,1.3vw,12px)/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#bedae4;text-align:center;width:100%;flex-shrink:0}
#menu-dialog .rank-footnote{font-size:10px;color:#d5e5ec;text-align:center}
#menu-dialog.name-view{inset:clamp(14px,9vh,90px) clamp(15px,24vw,410px);padding:14px;border-radius:14px;text-shadow:none;font:800 16px/1.35 system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:center}
#menu-dialog.name-view h2{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
#menu-dialog.name-view input[type=text]{width:min(100%,310px);height:44px;border:2px solid #8ee3b5;border-radius:9px;background:#f8fffc;padding:8px 10px;font:750 17px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#102733;outline-offset:3px}
#menu-dialog.name-view p{max-width:95%;font-size:clamp(12px,2vw,17px)}
#menu-dialog.name-view .name-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
#menu-dialog.name-view button{border:2px solid #fff1b9;border-radius:10px;min-width:100px;min-height:38px;padding:7px 12px;background:#197c71;color:#fff;font:800 13px system-ui,sans-serif}
#menu-dialog .rank-status{color:#ffec99;font-size:12px;text-align:center}
@media(orientation:portrait){#menu-dialog.rank-view{inset:5% 3%}#menu-dialog.name-view{inset:28% 5%}#menu-dialog .rank-table th:last-child{width:72px}#menu-dialog .rank-table th:nth-child(3){width:69px}#menu-dialog .rank-table th:nth-child(4){width:57px}}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:470px){#menu-dialog.rank-view{inset:4px 9px;gap:4px;padding:6px}#menu-dialog.rank-view h2{font-size:19px}#menu-dialog .rank-table td{padding:4px 4px}#menu-dialog .rank-table th{padding:5px 4px}#menu-dialog.rank-view button{min-height:25px;padding:3px 7px}#menu-dialog .rank-footer{display:none}#menu-dialog.name-view{inset:8px 15%;gap:4px}#menu-dialog.name-view input[type=text]{height:34px}}

/* Tela de vitória compacta: botões de ranking e reinício sempre visíveis. */
#victory{gap:clamp(1px,.4vh,4px);justify-content:space-evenly;overflow:hidden;padding:4px 5px}
#victory .victory-title{font-size:clamp(14px,3.1vw,28px);line-height:1.05;margin:0}
#victory .victory-subtitle{font-size:clamp(10px,1.9vw,16px);line-height:1.08;margin:0;text-align:center}
#victory .victory-image{max-height:36%;max-width:85%;min-height:0;flex:0 1 auto;object-fit:contain}
#victory .victory-score{font-size:clamp(10px,2.0vw,17px);line-height:1.13;text-align:center;max-width:98%;flex:0 0 auto}
#victory #victory-ranking,#victory #play-again{flex:0 0 auto;min-height:27px!important;max-height:32px;padding:2px 12px!important;border-radius:9px;font-size:clamp(11px,1.6vw,15px)!important;line-height:1.1}

/* Resultado final: tela realmente preta, sem imagem, pontuação extra ou ranking. */
#victory[hidden]{display:none!important}
#victory{
 position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;width:100vw!important;height:100vh!important;height:100dvh!important;
 z-index:1000!important;overflow-y:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;
 display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
 background:#000!important;color:#f4f6f3!important;text-shadow:none!important;
 border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left))!important;
}
#victory .final-victory-content{width:min(94vw,540px);max-height:100%;margin:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:clamp(10px,3vh,24px);flex:0 1 auto}
#victory .victory-title{font:900 clamp(25px,5vw,42px)/1.12 system-ui,sans-serif!important;color:#f7faf5!important;letter-spacing:.05em;text-align:center;margin:0!important;flex:0 0 auto}
#victory .final-victory-report{width:100%;font:600 clamp(16px,2.4vw,23px)/1.5 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-start;min-height:clamp(150px,26vh,250px);color:#e5f3e9;white-space:pre-wrap;text-align:left}
#victory #final-typewriter{font:inherit;letter-spacing:0;margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-align:left;flex:0 1 auto}
#victory .final-cursor{font:inherit;color:#8fefb1;animation:finalCursorBlink .75s steps(1,end) infinite;align-self:flex-end}
@keyframes finalCursorBlink{50%{opacity:0}}
#victory #play-again{flex:0 0 auto!important;min-width:190px!important;min-height:44px!important;max-height:none!important;border-radius:13px!important;border:2px solid #fce4a4!important;background:#eebd4b!important;color:#251b09!important;font:900 clamp(14px,2vw,19px)/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif!important;padding:10px 18px!important;margin:0!important;cursor:pointer}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:470px){
 #victory .final-victory-content{gap:7px!important;width:min(88vw,510px)}
 #victory .victory-title{font-size:clamp(19px,5.6vh,29px)!important}
 #victory .final-victory-report{font-size:clamp(13px,3.8vh,18px)!important;line-height:1.24!important;min-height:0!important}
 #victory #play-again{min-height:34px!important;padding:5px 13px!important;font-size:14px!important}
}
@media (orientation:portrait) and (max-width:450px){
 #victory .final-victory-report{font-size:clamp(16px,4.2vw,21px);line-height:1.55}
}

/* Tela final com dois caminhos e créditos discretos. */
#victory .final-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;width:100%}
#victory #return-to-menu{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:190px;min-height:44px;max-height:none;border:2px solid #95e1ca;border-radius:13px;background:#176f62;color:#fff;font:900 clamp(13px,1.9vw,17px)/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif;padding:10px 15px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:none}
#victory #final-credits{position:fixed;right:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-right));bottom:max(9px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));font:500 clamp(10px,1.35vw,13px)/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#b7b7b7;opacity:.76;text-align:right;pointer-events:none}
@media(max-height:470px) and (orientation:landscape){
 #victory .final-actions{gap:8px}
 #victory #return-to-menu,#victory #play-again{min-width:165px!important;min-height:32px!important;padding:5px 9px!important;font-size:13px!important}
 #victory .final-victory-content{gap:5px!important}
 #victory .final-victory-report{line-height:1.17!important}
 #victory #final-credits{font-size:10px}
}
@media(orientation:portrait) and (max-width:480px){#victory .final-actions{flex-direction:column;gap:9px}#victory #return-to-menu,#victory #play-again{min-width:min(80vw,285px)!important}}
/* Pause: overlay above gameplay, not part of the game physics. */
#game-pause-overlay[hidden]{display:none!important}
#game-pause-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:35;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;background:rgba(2,13,26,.73);touch-action:none}
#game-pause-overlay .game-pause-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:15px;align-items:center;padding:22px 30px;background:#122d47;border:3px solid #ffe297;box-shadow:0 7px 0 #071326;max-width:96%}
#game-pause-overlay h2{color:#fff4c0;font:1000 clamp(19px,4vw,32px)/1.1 monospace;margin:0}
#game-pause-overlay #pause-resume{min-height:44px;min-width:180px;font:900 17px system-ui,sans-serif;border:2px solid #d4fff5;border-radius:12px;background:#1d886b;color:white;box-shadow:none;touch-action:manipulation}
@media(max-height:440px){#game-pause-overlay .game-pause-panel{padding:12px 22px;gap:10px}#game-pause-overlay #pause-resume{min-height:36px}}
